# Wisdom of Solomon Chapter 3 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Wisdom 3 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/WIS_003_page_001.jpg

---

**3:1** But the souls of the righteous are in the hand of God, and no torment will touch them.

**3:2** In the eyes of the foolish they seemed to have died, and their departure was counted an affliction,

**3:3** and their journey from us a catastrophe; but they are at peace.

**3:4** For even if in the sight of men they are punished, their hope is full of immortality.

**3:5** And having been disciplined a little, they will be greatly benefited; because God tested them and found them worthy of himself.

**3:6** As gold in the furnace he proved them, and as a whole burnt offering he received them.

**3:7** And in the time of their visitation they will shine out, and as sparks through stubble they will run to and fro.

**3:8** They will judge nations and rule over peoples, and the Lord will reign over them forever.

**3:9** Those who trust in him will understand truth, and the faithful will abide with him in love; because grace and mercy are with his holy ones, and care is for his elect.

**3:10** But the ungodly will be punished according to their reasoning, those who neglected righteousness and forsook the Lord.

**3:11** For whoever despises wisdom and instruction is miserable, and their hope is empty, and their labors are unprofitable, and their works are useless.

**3:12** Their wives are foolish and their children wicked; their offspring is accursed.

**3:13** For blessed is the barren woman who is undefiled, who has not known a bed in transgression; she will have fruit at the visitation of souls.

**3:14** And blessed is the eunuch who has not worked iniquity with his hands, nor devised wicked things against the Lord; for to him will be given a choice gift of faithfulness, and a most acceptable lot in the temple of the Lord.

**3:15** For the fruit of good labors is glorious, and the root of understanding does not fail.

**3:16** But the children of adulterers will not be brought to completion, and the seed of an unlawful bed will disappear.

**3:17** For even if they live long they will be held in no account, and at the last their old age will be without honor.

**3:18** And if they die early, they will have no hope and no consolation on the day of judgment.

**3:19** For the end of an unrighteous generation is grievous.

---

*EMET notes: 3:1 is among the most cited verses in all wisdom literature — psuchai dikaiōn en cheiri theou, "souls of the righteous in the hand of God." The metaphor of gold tested in a furnace (v. 6) is also found in Prov 17:3, Ps 66:10. "Visitation" (episkopē, vv. 7, 13) — a technical term for divine visitation/inspection. "Whole burnt offering" (holokautōma) preserves the sacrificial image literally.*
